name: com.sosxr.seashark
description: A comprehensive collection of C# extensions, utilities, and design pattern implementations for Unity. Provides lightweight, reusable components for gameplay, UI, and system architecture.

samples.description: Runtime permission handling for Android builds (requires https://github.com/yasirkula/UnityAndroidRuntimePermissions.git)
Animation Rigging helpers. Requires com.unity.animation.rigging, com.sosxr.enhancedlogger and ScriptableObject-Architecture; the sample assembly is skipped until they are installed.
Sample configuration data using ScriptableObjects and lightweight data wrappers
Design pattern samples demonstrating common solutions. The Mediator Timeline sample and CopyTransform need ScriptableObject-Architecture (and Timeline); they compile only when those are installed.
Contains Maple Mono and other fonts
Contains Input System actions and helpers
Shader Graph poke deformation. Requires com.sosxr.enhancedlogger and ScriptableObject-Architecture; the sample assembly is skipped until they are installed.
Contains useful Unity Experiment Framework tools. Requires UXF to be installed. See https://github.com/immersivecognition/unity-experiment-framework
